next_actions: Fix the synthetic caller language declaration so Punjabi is a valid target language.
Remove opening repetition through deterministic turn-state or workflow control rather than prompt wording alone.
Make tool-before-claim enforceable in the orchestration layer and expose tool events directly to the evaluator.
Run the same three pilots again; run the 18-case matched suite only after all three are valid and required effects pass.
claim_boundary: The project proves deployed Indus prompt/version control, authenticated live tool mutation, realtime bot-to-bot evaluation and a functioning release gate. It does not prove live voice lift or production readiness.
